rag.text:
Test: TC-5968 — SPM - Priorities - Changing template of prioritized Goals on Gantt module
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/Priorities
Labels: ppm-e2e-cloud

Steps:
1. Open OKR module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-5968 SPM - Priorities - Changing template of prioritized Goals on Gantt module
   Expected: OKR module is displayed
2. Create Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result
   Expected: OKRs are created
3. Open box configuration → Scope definition and add Strategic theme to the scope
   Expected: Strategic theme is added to the scope. Task counter displays 0 issue
4. Go to task structure and enable OKR task structure
   Expected: OKR task structure is enabled
5. Open Gantt module
   Expected: Gantt module is opened Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result are visible in WBS
6. Click on add column button and add Priority score column
   Expected: Priority score column is added. Columns have no values
7. Navigate to Priorities module → Goals tab
   Expected: Strategic theme, Objective and Key-result are visible without score values
8. Go to Configuration → Goals
   Expected: Prioritization template ICE is selected
9. Navigate back to Goals →  Strategic theme and set values
   Data: * Impact:  *near zero*
* Ease: *extremely hard*
* Confidence: *no confidence*
   Expected: Score 1 is visible for strategic theme
10. Navigate to Objective and set values
   Data: * Impact: *low*
* Ease: *hard*
* Confidence: *very low*
   Expected: Score 36 is visible for objective
11. Navigate to Key-result and set values
   Data: * Impact: *High*
* Ease: *Easy*
* Confidence: *Medium*
   Expected: Score 336 is visible for key result
12. Open Gantt module and check priority score values for OKRs
   Expected: The values are visible and the same as in Priorities module

*1* - for Strategic theme
*36* - for Objective 
*366* - for Key-resuilt
13. Open Priority module → Goals → Click List view → Configure and change template to RISE. Click save changes
   Expected: Prioritization template is swiched to RISE. After saving Goals tab is opened. 
RISE template is visible with empty score values
14. Open Gantt module and refresh the page
   Expected: Priority score column has empty values for OKRs
15. Open Priority module → Configuration → Goals and change template to ICE. Click save changes
   Expected: Prioritization template is swiched to ICE. After saving Goals tab is opened.
ICE template is visible with score values


*1* - for Strategic theme
*36* - for Objective
*366* - for Key-resuilt
16. Open Gantt module and refresh the page. Check priority score values for goals
   Expected: The values are visible and the same as in Priorities module

*1* - for Strategic theme
*36* - for Objective
*366* - for Key-resuilt
